{{Quote|This is Republic sovereign territory per the Makeb treaty. Diplomatic envoys require proper authorization. Vacate immediately.|Fideltin Rusk|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>}}
The '''Makeb treaty''' was a formal alliance established between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the remaining leaders of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] after the [[Conquest of Makeb]] saw the Cartel decimated and their leader [[Toborro]] killed. The deal was originally agreed upon by the remaining [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] leaders to ensure their safe passage off the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] before its destruction, and under the directive of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] it became an official alliance. Its terms included the building of a new colony world for Makeb's people by the Hutts, the Republic gaining control of the Hutts' warships, and the Republic's ability to claim sovereign territory on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. It was amicably annulled by the leader of the Cartel, [[Brogol]], after the [[War against Zakuul]].
